description: Set Cell Options (Table > Cell Options) on a block of cells: text insets, vertical justification, paragraph spacing limit, first baseline, clipping, text rotation and writing direction, plus paragraph and character styles, size and alignment of the cell text; graphic cell insets and clipping; strokes on chosen edges and the fill; row height (Exactly or At Least, with a maximum), start row and keep with next; column width; and diagonal lines. Also the sizing and alignment controls of the Table panel

cells.description: Which cells of the table; omitted means every cell. Give rows and/or columns, or region, or selection: true for the selected cells

region.description: Every row of one region: header, body or footer rows

rows.description: Rows (header rows count) as [first, last] (0-based, inclusive), or [one]

selection.description: Use the selected cells (or the cell holding the text cursor); the table is then the selection's

columns.description: Rows and Columns tab: applies to every column the cells span

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

inFront.description: Draw the line in front of the cell content (false: behind it)

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

rows.description: Rows and Columns tab: applies to every row the cells span

maximum.description: Maximum height in mm for At Least rows

mode.description: At Least (the row grows with its content) or Exactly

startRow.description: Start Row: where the row begins when the table breaks

strokes.description: Strokes and Fills tab: the cell stroke on the chosen edges

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

edges.description: Edges of the chosen block of cells, as in the proxy: top, bottom, left, right, inner_rows, inner_columns, or border, inner, all (default all)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

table.description: Which table. Give frameId, storyId or pageIndex with index (which table, 0-based), or selection: true for the table holding the selection. Add nested to reach a table inside a cell. get_table_info lists every table with its storyId and index

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; index counts the tables in that frame

nested.description: Path to a table nested in cells: each step goes into the cell at (row, column) of the current table and takes its index-th table

column.description: Column of the cell holding the nested table

row.description: Row of the cell holding the nested table

pageIndex.description: 0-based page index; index counts the tables in the page's text frames, frame by frame

selection.description: Use the table holding the selection: selected cells, a text cursor in a cell, or a selected text frame's first table

storyId.description: Story id; index counts the tables in the story

text.description: Text tab, and formatting of the cell text

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment of the cell text

characterStyle.description: Character style to apply to the cell text

paragraphSpacingLimit.description: Paragraph Spacing Limit in mm (with justify)

paragraphStyle.description: Paragraph style to apply to the cell text

writingDirection.description: Writing direction of the cell text

name: set_cell_options
title: Set Cell Options
